ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at >90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the trailing edge margin and central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a thin, irregular boundary along the entire trailing edge and a cluster of vertical, linear mottling at the central base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a pixel angle estimated at 125 degrees and a shallow depth-to-span ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with approximately 14-18 distinct peaks per lobe; pixel-amplitudes vary between 5 and 15 pixels across the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed on the lateral leading edges, transitioning into a multi-inflection serrated concave curve towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-relief indentations and high-contrast pixel clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the mid-section of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct low-intensity diagonal linear marks on the lower-left lobe and one horizontal mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-contrast, calcified white nodules (barnacles) are present on the extreme lateral tips of the trailing edges.
